newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan to form sales finance unit in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Nissan to form sales finance unit in Britain.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday that it plans to form a sales finance company in Britain next month to provide retail financing for its customers there.
The new company, to be called Nissan Finance (GB) Ltd, is scheduled to begin retail financing and leasing of Nissan vehicles in April 1998, Nissan said in a statement.
The new unit will allow Nissan to respond more flexibly to the growing needs of retail financing in that market and help it increase car sales and profitability, Nissan said.
About 60 percent of all new cars sold in Britain are done so with some form of financing, it said.

Earlier on Thursday, Nissan, the second-largest Japanese carmaker, said it was not reviewing its global investment strategy, including the status of its base in Britain, over the issue of European economic and monetary union.
It said it had no intention now of changing Britain's status as an important base for Nissan to supply cars to the rest of Europe and elsewhere.
Also on Thursday, Japan's top carmaker Toyota Motor Corp said that it was studying its future investment plans in Europe but no decisions had been made.
